lines.text: During a famine, Elimelech takes his wife Naomi and his sons Mahlon and Chilion from Bethlehem to Moab.
Elimelech dies, the sons marry Orpah and Ruth, and after living in Moab about seven years both sons die.
Naomi hears the LORD has provided food, and she sets out for Judah and tells her daughters-in-law to go back.
Orpah kisses Naomi goodbye, but Ruth clings to her and says Naomi's God will be her God.
In Bethlehem, Naomi asks to be called Leah, and she and Ruth arrive at the start of the barley harvest.
